lines: Meet Priya, asked to fine-tune a small open model for her support desk.
She opens its config file and stares at unfamiliar names.
RoPE theta, KV heads, intermediate size: each one changes memory, speed and cost.
Without them, she can't tell if it fits her GPU.

lines: This module gives her, and you, the map.
We build up from tensors until that config reads like plain English.
Every LLM, toy or frontier, is trained by the same loop.
Get a batch, compute the loss, backpropagate, and update the weights.

lines: Lesson one teaches the PyTorch behind it: tensor shapes and autograd.
You'll train a tiny bigram model on Shakespeare in under a minute.
Lesson two adds self-attention.
Each token's query meets earlier tokens' keys and gathers a mix of their values.
A causal mask hides the future, and several heads look for different patterns.
Add an MLP and residual connections, and you have a transformer block.

say.1: Add an M L P and residual connections, and you have a transformer block.

lines: In the lab, you stack those blocks into a three-million-parameter GPT.
